name: Nicaragua
about: Dry season Nov–Apr is best for beaches and volcano hikes; wet season (May–Oct) brings mostly afternoon showers rather than all-day rain, with Sep–Oct the wettest stretch.
overview: Volcanoes, colonial Granada and León, and a growing surf scene on the Pacific coast — Central America's best-value alternative to Costa Rica.
costOverview: Genuinely the best value in Central America — similar volcanoes, beaches, and colonial towns to Costa Rica at a fraction of the price.
monthlyWeather: dry and hot, one of the sunniest and most popular months to visit
